name: Edison Format

unresolved_policy.reason: Edison has no reference implementation to reproduce (unlike Goat Format), so where a record's chronology cannot place a change relative to 2010-04-24 this format keeps the MODERN implementation rather than assert unproven period behaviour. Two things justify the conservative direction. First, the community's own definition of Edison-era card behaviour is enumerative: EdisonFormat.com publishes a Functional Errata list of exactly those cards whose 2010 behaviour differs, so a card absent from it has no documented era divergence to reproduce. Second, most unresolved records here are undated 2005-era ruling differences carried by Project Ignis's GOAT variants (damage-step activation windows, miss-timing registration); substituting a GOAT variant on unresolved chronology would assert 2005 behaviour for 2010 without evidence - precisely the inference this project exists to eliminate. Every card the policy is applied to is named individually by the validator (format.erratum-unresolved-defaulted) and counted by 'report', so the residual uncertainty is visible and shrinks as chronology is researched. Records whose chronology IS resolved ignore this policy entirely and select the correct historical version automatically.

defining_events.name: Shonen Jump Championship Edison, New Jersey (75th SJC)

notes: period: the March 2010 TCG list took effect 2010-03-01 and EdisonFormat.com bounds the format at 2010-05-10, the day before The Shining Darkness's NA release; snapshot is SJC Edison day 1 (2010-04-24), the event the format is named for. chronology: Format Library names the neighbours 'Lightsworn' (previous) and 'Frog' (next); left null here until those formats exist in this repository. card_pool: materialised from data/releases/ and cross-checked against YGOPRODeck's Edison tag and the termitaklk community whitelist (see the pool record's notes for the adjudicated differences). errata: applicability is computed from each record's reviewed chronology against the 2010-04-24 snapshot (no hand-written Edison errata list); currently 72 historical implementations are substituted this way. Where chronology cannot place a change relative to the snapshot, errata_overrides.unresolved_policy keeps the modern implementation rather than assert unproven period behaviour, and the validator names and counts every card this was applied to, including the cases known to be wrong for lack of a better determinate answer (format.erratum-modern-known-wrong). See docs/errata.md and run `python -m retroformats report -v` for the current figures.
